title: Personality and eating disorders
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's personality or eating disorder.
note:

Follow-up for weight maintenance.

Multivitamin, daily.

Psych: Calm, cooperative, good eye contact.
Physical: NAD.

Assessment

Plan
1. Continue current nutritional plan.
2. Follow up in 3 months.
3. Encourage continued maintenance of healthy habits.

Electronically signed,
